name: issue-driven-dev
description: v3.1.0: idd-discuss captures explicitly selected human/AI conversations as append-only GitHub Discussion snapshots (#331). Stable topic/source IDs, payload fingerprints, shared egress checks, local locks and uncertain-write reconciliation protect retry behavior without promising distributed exactly-once or AI correctness. idd-ask adds bounded Discussion/comment/reply evidence alongside existing issue retrieval, with corpus selection and explicit partial-read reporting.
